notes.title: 🍀Gardener Plant Creator🍀 and 🐶Farmer's Life - Pimp my Cottage DLC😺 Release
notes.notes:
Farming Fest Event Starts

Steam Farming Fest has just launched. What impact does it have on you, what can you benefit from it?

Firstly, you can get the Farmer's Life game with the best discount ever 40%!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/


Secondly, we have just launched a much anticipated DLC "Pimp my Cottage DLC"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926840/Farmers_Life__Pimp_my_Cottage_DLC

You can even get it cheaper in a bundle: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40608/Pets_on_the_Farm


Don't have or don't want to spend any $ today? Fine. We have an offer for that also.

Gardener Plant Creator has launched today. Try it, it's free. It's a unique "introduction" to the Gardener game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2813710/Gardener_Plant_Creator

Have fun!
FreeMind
